CREATE TRIGGER dbo.SOD_trg_WO_History_Order ON dbo.[Order] AFTER INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE AS
    BEGIN
        SET NOCOUNT ON;
        INSERT dbo.SOD_WO_History(OrderID, EventName, Actor, Terminal, Details)
        SELECT COALESCE(i.ID, d.ID),
            CASE WHEN d.ID IS NULL THEN N'Order created' WHEN i.ID IS NULL THEN N'Order removed'
                 WHEN i.Closed = 1 AND d.Closed = 0 THEN N'Order closed'
                 WHEN i.Type <> d.Type THEN N'Order type changed' ELSE N'Order edited' END,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(CONVERT(nvarchar(128), SESSION_CONTEXT(N'SOD_WO_Actor')), N''), ORIGINAL_LOGIN()), LEFT(CONCAT(HOST_NAME(), N' / ', CONVERT(nvarchar(128), SESSION_CONTEXT(N'SOD_WO_Register'))), 256),
            LEFT(CONCAT(N'Type: ', d.Type, N' -> ', i.Type,
                N'; customer: ', d.CustomerID, N' -> ', i.CustomerID,
                N'; sales rep: ', d.SalesRepID, N' -> ', i.SalesRepID,
                N'; total: ', d.Total, N' -> ', i.Total,
                N'; tax: ', d.Tax, N' -> ', i.Tax,
                N'; tax reason: ', d.DefaultTaxChangeReasonCodeID, N' -> ', i.DefaultTaxChangeReasonCodeID,
                N'; remarks: ', LEFT(CONVERT(nvarchar(max), d.Comment), 300),
                N' -> ', LEFT(CONVERT(nvarchar(max), i.Comment), 300)), 2000)
        FROM inserted i FULL JOIN deleted d ON i.ID = d.ID
        WHERE i.ID IS NULL OR d.ID IS NULL OR EXISTS (
            SELECT i.Type, i.Closed, i.CustomerID, i.SalesRepID, i.Total, i.Tax,
                   i.DefaultTaxChangeReasonCodeID, CONVERT(nvarchar(max), i.Comment)
            EXCEPT SELECT d.Type, d.Closed, d.CustomerID, d.SalesRepID, d.Total, d.Tax,
                   d.DefaultTaxChangeReasonCodeID, CONVERT(nvarchar(max), d.Comment));
    END

CREATE TRIGGER dbo.SOD_trg_WO_History_Entry ON dbo.OrderEntry AFTER INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE AS
    BEGIN
        SET NOCOUNT ON;
        INSERT dbo.SOD_WO_History(OrderID, EventName, Actor, Terminal, ItemID, Details)
        SELECT COALESCE(i.OrderID, d.OrderID),
            CASE WHEN d.ID IS NULL THEN N'Item added' WHEN i.ID IS NULL THEN N'Item removed' ELSE N'Item edited' END,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(CONVERT(nvarchar(128), SESSION_CONTEXT(N'SOD_WO_Actor')), N''), ORIGINAL_LOGIN()), LEFT(CONCAT(HOST_NAME(), N' / ', CONVERT(nvarchar(128), SESSION_CONTEXT(N'SOD_WO_Register'))), 256), COALESCE(i.ItemID, d.ItemID),
            LEFT(CONCAT(N'Entry: ', COALESCE(i.ID, d.ID), N'; quantity: ', d.QuantityOnOrder,
                N' -> ', i.QuantityOnOrder, N'; price: ', d.Price, N' -> ', i.Price,
                N'; full price: ', d.FullPrice, N' -> ', i.FullPrice,
                N'; taxable: ', d.Taxable, N' -> ', i.Taxable,
                N'; tax reason: ', d.TaxChangeReasonCodeID, N' -> ', i.TaxChangeReasonCodeID,
                N'; description: ', LEFT(CONVERT(nvarchar(max), d.Description), 200),
                N' -> ', LEFT(CONVERT(nvarchar(max), i.Description), 200),
                N'; pick location: ', LEFT(CONVERT(nvarchar(max), d.Comment), 200),
                N' -> ', LEFT(CONVERT(nvarchar(max), i.Comment), 200)), 2000)
        FROM inserted i FULL JOIN deleted d ON i.ID = d.ID
        WHERE i.ID IS NULL OR d.ID IS NULL OR EXISTS (
            SELECT i.OrderID, i.ItemID, i.QuantityOnOrder, i.Price, i.FullPrice, i.Taxable,
                   i.TaxChangeReasonCodeID, CONVERT(nvarchar(max), i.Description), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), i.Comment)
            EXCEPT SELECT d.OrderID, d.ItemID, d.QuantityOnOrder, d.Price, d.FullPrice, d.Taxable,
                   d.TaxChangeReasonCodeID, CONVERT(nvarchar(max), d.Description), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), d.Comment));
    END

CREATE TRIGGER [tr_OrderEntry_D] ON [dbo].[OrderEntry] 
FOR DELETE
AS

DECLARE @Type as integer,
	@OrderID	as float,
	@StoreID	as integer,
	@ItemLookupCode	as nvarchar(25)

-- GET Order ID, Store ID & ItemLookup
SELECT @OrderID = D.OrderID, @StoreID = D.StoreID, @ItemLookupCode = ISNULL(I.ItemLookupCode,'')
  FROM Deleted D
 INNER JOIN Item I WITH(NOLOCK) ON D.ItemID = I.[ID]

-- GET ORDER TYPE
SELECT @Type = Type FROM [Order] WITH(NOLOCK)
 WHERE [ID] = @OrderID AND StoreID = @StoreID


IF @TYPE = 5
BEGIN

   DELETE FROM RMSTMP_Layaway
    WHERE TransactionNumber = @OrderID AND StoreID = @StoreID AND ItemLookupCode = @ItemLookupCode

END

CREATE TRIGGER tr_OrderEntry_I ON [dbo].[OrderEntry]
AFTER INSERT
AS

DECLARE @Type 		as integer,
	@OrderID	as float,
	@StoreID	as integer,
        @TaxDiv 	as money,
        @CustomerCode 	as nvarchar(20),
        @InvoiceNumber  as nvarchar(50),
        @Comment	as nvarchar(255)

-- GET Order ID & Store ID
SELECT @OrderID = OrderID, @StoreID = StoreID FROM Inserted


-- GET ORDER TYPE, Customer Code, ReferenceNumber and Comment
SELECT @Type = O.Type, @CustomerCode = ISNULL(C.AccountNumber,'Missing'),
       @InvoiceNumber = ISNULL(O.ReferenceNumber,''), @Comment = ISNULL(O.Comment,'')
  FROM [Order] O WITH(NOLOCK)
  LEFT JOIN Customer C ON O.CustomerID = C.[ID]
 WHERE O.[ID] = @OrderID AND O.StoreID = @StoreID
 
-- GET CASHIER NAME
-- CashierName can be found only after creation of record in OrderHistory
-- There's another trigger for OrderHistory in order to get CashierName
 
-- GET TAX DIVIDER
SELECT @TaxDiv=1+(T.Percentage/100)
  FROM Tax T
 INNER JOIN ItemTax IT ON T.[ID]=IT.TaxID01
 WHERE T.Percentage <> 0

IF @TYPE = 5
BEGIN

	INSERT INTO RMSTMP_Layaway
	   (StoreID,
	    TransactionNumber,
	    TransactionDate,
	    ItemLookupCode,
	    SellingPrice,
	    Quantity,
	    TaxableAmount,
	    TaxAmount,
	    DiscountAmount,
	    CustomerCode,
	    SalesRepName,
	    ReasonCode1,
	    ReasonCode2,
	    CashierName,
	    InvoiceNumber,
	    Comment)

	SELECT 
	    INS.StoreID,
	    INS.OrderID,
	    INS.LastUpdated,
	    I.ItemLookupCode,
	    INS.Price,
	    INS.QuantityOnOrder,
	    INS.Price,
	    ((INS.Price-(INS.Price/@TaxDiv)) * INS.QuantityOnOrder) * INS.Taxable,
	    (INS.FullPrice - INS.Price)*INS.QuantityOnOrder,
	    @CustomerCode,
	    ISNULL(S.[Name],''),
	    ISNULL(R.Code,''),
	    ISNULL(R2.Code,''),
	    '',
	    @InvoiceNumber,
	    @Comment
	 FROM Inserted INS  
        INNER JOIN Item I ON INS.ItemID = I.[ID]
         LEFT JOIN SalesRep S ON INS.SalesRepID = S.[ID]
         LEFT JOIN ReasonCode R ON INS.DiscountReasonCodeID = R.[ID]
         LEFT JOIN ReasonCode R2 ON INS.ReturnReasonCodeID = R2.[ID]
        
END

CREATE TRIGGER [tr_OrderEntry_U] ON [dbo].[OrderEntry] 
AFTER UPDATE
AS

DECLARE @Type as integer,
	@OrderID	as float,
	@StoreID	as integer,
        @TaxDiv 	as money,
	@ItemLookupCode	as nvarchar(25),
	@CustomerCode 	as nvarchar(20),
	@InvoiceNumber  as nvarchar(50),
	@Comment	as nvarchar(255)


-- GET Order ID, Store ID & ItemLookup
SELECT @OrderID = INS.OrderID, @StoreID = INS.StoreID, @ItemLookupCode = ISNULL(I.ItemLookupCode,'')
  FROM INSERTED INS
 INNER JOIN Item I WITH(NOLOCK) ON INS.ItemID = I.[ID]

-- GET ORDER TYPE, Customer Code, ReferenceNumber and Comment
SELECT @Type = O.Type, @CustomerCode = ISNULL(C.AccountNumber,'Missing'),
       @InvoiceNumber = ISNULL(O.ReferenceNumber,''), @Comment = ISNULL(O.Comment,'')
  FROM [Order] O WITH(NOLOCK)
  LEFT JOIN Customer C ON O.CustomerID = C.[ID]
 WHERE O.[ID] = @OrderID AND O.StoreID = @StoreID

-- GET TAX DIVIDER
SELECT @TaxDiv=1+(T.Percentage/100)
  FROM Tax T
 INNER JOIN ItemTax IT ON T.[ID]=IT.TaxID01
 WHERE T.Percentage <> 0


IF @TYPE = 5	-- LAYAWAY
BEGIN

	UPDATE L
           SET TransactionDate = INS.LastUpdated,
               SellingPrice = INS.Price,
               Quantity = INS.QuantityOnOrder,
               TaxableAmount = INS.Price,
               TaxAmount = ((INS.Price-(INS.Price / @TaxDiv)) * INS.QuantityOnOrder) * INS.Taxable,
               DiscountAmount = (INS.FullPrice - INS.Price) * INS.QuantityOnOrder,
               CustomerCode = @CustomerCode,
	       SalesRepName = ISNULL(S.[Name],''),
	       ReasonCode1 = ISNULL(R.Code,''),
	       ReasonCode2 = ISNULL(R2.Code,''),
               InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNumber,
               Comment = @Comment
          FROM RMSTMP_Layaway L
         INNER JOIN INSERTED INS ON L.TransactionNumber = INS.OrderID
                AND L.StoreID = INS.StoreID AND L.ItemLookupCode = @ItemLookupCode
          LEFT JOIN SalesRep S ON INS.SalesRepID = S.[ID]
          LEFT JOIN ReasonCode R ON INS.DiscountReasonCodeID = R.[ID]
          LEFT JOIN ReasonCode R2 ON INS.ReturnReasonCodeID = R2.[ID]

END

CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[trg_OrderEntry_ItemLogs]
   ON [dbo].[OrderEntry]
   AFTER INSERT, UPDATE
AS BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;    

	declare @Qty integer
	declare @exist integer
	declare @Orderid integer
	declare @Itemid integer
	declare @lastcommitted integer

	set @Orderid = (select orderid from deleted)
	set @Qty = (select QuantityOnOrder from inserted)
	set @Itemid = (select itemid from deleted)
	set @exist = (select count(id) from [Order] where id = @Orderid)
	IF @Qty <> 0 AND @exist > 0
    BEGIN
        set @lastcommitted = (select top 1 NewCommitted  from SOD_Item_Logs where ItemID = @Itemid and ReferenceID = @Orderid order by date desc )
    END
	
	if @qty != 0
	begin
			if @exist > 0
			begin

			insert into SOD_Item_Logs(ItemID,ItemLookupCode,[Type],ReferenceID ,QuantityORIS ,LastQuantity,NewQuantity,LastCommitted,NewCommitted,Date)(
			select i.ID,i.ItemLookupCode,'Order Update Logs',n.orderid,x.QuantityOnOrder , i.Quantity ,i.Quantity,
			 @lastcommitted,
			i.QuantityCommitted as 'NewCommitted' , GEtdate()

			from deleted n
			inner join inserted x on n.id = x.id
			inner join item i on n.ItemID = i.id
			)

			end
			else if @exist <= 0
			begin

			insert into SOD_Item_Logs(ItemID,ItemLookupCode,[Type],ReferenceID ,QuantityORIS ,LastQuantity,NewQuantity,LastCommitted,NewCommitted,Date)
			(
			select i.ID,i.ItemLookupCode,'Order Entry Logs',n.orderid,n.QuantityOnOrder , i.Quantity ,i.Quantity,i.QuantityCommitted,i.QuantityCommitted + n.QuantityOnOrder as 'NewCommitted' , GEtdate()
			from inserted n
			inner join item i on n.ItemID = i.id
			)
			end
	end
	
END

CREATE TRIGGER tr_OrderHistory_I ON [dbo].[OrderHistory]
AFTER INSERT
AS

DECLARE @Type 		as integer,
	@OrderID	as float,
	@StoreID	as integer,
        @CashierName 	as nvarchar(50),
        @RegisterNo	as integer,
        @BatchNumber	as integer


-- GET Order ID, Store ID, CashierName, RegisterNumber
SELECT @OrderID = INS.OrderID, @StoreID = INS.StoreID, @CashierName = ISNULL(CS.[Name],''), @RegisterNo = ISNULL(R.Number,0)
  FROM Inserted INS
  LEFT JOIN Cashier CS WITH(NOLOCK) ON INS.CashierID = CS.[ID] 
  LEFT JOIN Batch B WITH(NOLOCK) ON INS.BatchNumber = B.BatchNumber
  LEFT JOIN Register R WITH(NOLOCK) ON B.RegisterID = R.[ID]

-- GET ORDER TYPE
SELECT @Type = Type FROM [Order] WITH(NOLOCK)
 WHERE [ID] = @OrderID AND StoreID = @StoreID
 
-- GET REGISTER NUMBER
--SELECT @RegisterNo = ISNULL(R.Number,0) FROM Batch B WITH(NOLOCK)
--  LEFT JOIN Register R WITH(NOLOCK) ON B.RegisterID = R.[ID]
-- WHERE B.BatchNumber = @BatchNumber

 
IF @TYPE = 5	-- LAYAWAY
BEGIN

   UPDATE RMSTMP_Layaway
      SET CashierName = @CashierName,
          Register = @RegisterNo
    WHERE TransactionNumber = @OrderID 
      AND StoreID = @StoreID

END

CREATE TRIGGER dbo.SOD_trg_WO_History_Queue ON dbo.Queueing AFTER INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE AS
    BEGIN
        SET NOCOUNT ON;
        INSERT dbo.SOD_WO_History(OrderID, EventName, Actor, Terminal, Details)
        SELECT COALESCE(i.OrderID, d.OrderID),
            CASE WHEN d.id IS NULL THEN N'Ownership recorded' WHEN i.id IS NULL THEN N'Queue removed'
                 WHEN i.Status = 2 AND ISNULL(d.Status, -1) <> 2 THEN N'Order cancelled'
                 WHEN i.Status = 1 AND ISNULL(d.Status, -1) <> 1 THEN N'Queue completed'
                 WHEN ISNULL(i.GroupTo, -1) <> ISNULL(d.GroupTo, -1) THEN N'Order grouped / ungrouped'
                 ELSE N'Queue edited' END,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(CONVERT(nvarchar(128), SESSION_CONTEXT(N'SOD_WO_Actor')), N''), ORIGINAL_LOGIN()), LEFT(CONCAT(HOST_NAME(), N' / ', CONVERT(nvarchar(128), SESSION_CONTEXT(N'SOD_WO_Register'))), 256),
            LEFT(CONCAT(N'Queue: ', COALESCE(i.id, d.id), N'; status: ', d.Status, N' -> ', i.Status,
                N'; group: ', d.GroupTo, N' -> ', i.GroupTo, N'; owner: ', d.OPIS, N' -> ', i.OPIS), 2000)
        FROM inserted i FULL JOIN deleted d ON i.id = d.id
        WHERE COALESCE(i.OrderID, d.OrderID) IS NOT NULL AND
            (i.id IS NULL OR d.id IS NULL OR EXISTS (
                SELECT i.OrderID, i.Status, i.GroupTo, CONVERT(nvarchar(max), i.OPIS)
                EXCEPT SELECT d.OrderID, d.Status, d.GroupTo, CONVERT(nvarchar(max), d.OPIS)));
    END

CREATE TRIGGER dbo.SOD_trg_WO_History_Approval ON dbo.SOD_WO_LOGS AFTER INSERT AS
        BEGIN
            SET NOCOUNT ON;
            INSERT dbo.SOD_WO_History(OrderID, EventName, Actor, Terminal, ItemID, Details)
            SELECT i.OrderId,
                CASE WHEN i.Status = N'Deleted' THEN N'Item removal logged' ELSE N'Price approval recorded' END,
                COALESCE(NULLIF(CONVERT(nvarchar(128), SESSION_CONTEXT(N'SOD_WO_Actor')), N''), ORIGINAL_LOGIN()), LEFT(CONCAT(HOST_NAME(), N' / ', CONVERT(nvarchar(128), SESSION_CONTEXT(N'SOD_WO_Register'))), 256), i.ItemID,
                LEFT(CONCAT(N'Approver: ', i.ApprovedUser, N'; full price: ', i.FullPrice,
                    N'; selected price: ', i.UpdatedPrice, N'; action: ', i.Status), 2000)
            FROM inserted i WHERE i.OrderId IS NOT NULL;
        END

CREATE TRIGGER dbo.SOD_trg_WO_History_Invoice ON dbo.[Transaction] AFTER INSERT AS
    BEGIN
        SET NOCOUNT ON;
        INSERT dbo.SOD_WO_History(OrderID, EventName, Actor, Terminal, Details)
        SELECT i.RecallID, N'RMS transaction posted', COALESCE(NULLIF(CONVERT(nvarchar(128), SESSION_CONTEXT(N'SOD_WO_Actor')), N''), ORIGINAL_LOGIN()), LEFT(CONCAT(HOST_NAME(), N' / ', CONVERT(nvarchar(128), SESSION_CONTEXT(N'SOD_WO_Register'))), 256),
            CONCAT(N'Transaction: ', i.TransactionNumber, N'; RMS cashier ID: ', i.CashierID)
        FROM inserted i WHERE i.RecallID > 0 AND
            (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Queueing q WHERE q.OrderID = i.RecallID)
             OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.SOD_WO_History h WHERE h.OrderID = i.RecallID));
    END

CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[tr_Transaction_I] ON [dbo].[Transaction]
AFTER INSERT
AS

Declare @TransactionNumber	int,
 	@TransactionDate	datetime,
        @ORNumber    		nvarchar(100),
        @NewORNumber 		nvarchar(100),
        @RegisterNumber		int,
        @BatchNumber		int,
        @StoreID		int
        
SELECT @TransactionNumber = TransactionNumber, @StoreID = StoreID, @BatchNumber = BatchNumber, @TransactionDate = [Time]
  FROM Inserted

-- Get Register Number
SELECT @RegisterNumber = R.Number FROM Batch B 
 INNER JOIN Register R ON B.RegisterID = R.[ID]
 WHERE B.BatchNumber = @BatchNumber

BEGIN
	-- OR NUMBER	
  	SELECT TOP 1 @NewORNumber=dbo.fnAddLZeroes6(CONVERT(BigInt,NextORNumber)+1),
     	             @ORNumber=REPLACE(NextORNumber,' ','')
	  FROM SI_ORSERIES
	 WHERE RegisterNumber = @RegisterNumber
	 
	-- VALIDATE IF REGISTER IS INCLUDED IN OR SERIES
	IF (@ORNumber IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN

	   -- UPDATE THE TABLES
           UPDATE SI_ORSeries WITH (TABLOCKX)
              SET NextORNumber=@NewORNumber,
                  LastUpdated=getDate()
            WHERE RegisterNumber = @RegisterNumber

           UPDATE [Transaction] 
             SET ReferenceNumber = @ORNumber
           WHERE TransactionNumber = @TransactionNumber
             AND StoreID = @StoreID
		   AND RecallType = 0
           
           -- AUDIT TABLE
           INSERT INTO SI_ORSeries_Audit (StoreID, RegisterNumber, TransactionNumber, ORNumber, TransactionDate)
           SELECT @StoreID, @RegisterNumber, TransactionNumber, @ORNumber, [Time] FROM INSERTED
           
        END
        
END

CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[trg_Transaction_closeQueue]
   ON [dbo].[Transaction]
   AFTER INSERT
AS BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;    

	
	declare @exist integer
	declare @recallid integer
	
	set @recallid = (select RecallID from inserted)
	set @exist = (select count(*) from Queueing q where q.OrderID = @recallid )

	if @exist > 0
	begin
	 update Queueing set Status = 1 where OrderID = @recallid
	end

END
